data.text: I’m with Kate and Emma: I’ll choose 10 tons this month. My family taught me that a good catch should never cost the village its next one. Luke, I appreciate your offer, but there’s no need for you to sit out—we can each earn $10,000 and leave the lake full again next month. Let’s check the revealed catches together afterward and discuss any departures before the next round. Jack, we haven’t heard from you yet—will you agree to 10 tons too?
